SaaSHome.wantSimilar: Want to build a similar blazing fast platform?
SaaSHome.bentoSubtitle: Our platform is designed from the ground up to be blazing fast, AI-driven and extremely scalable.
SaaSHome.edgeDesc: Lightning fast load times. Your website is served from locations worldwide closest to your users via Vercel Edge Network.
SaaSHome.autonomousDesc: Full integration with modern LLMs and custom AI agents built right into the platform.
SaaSHome.i18nDesc: Static texts via i18nexus cloud and 1-click dynamic AI translation with Gemini Flash built into your admin panel.
SaaSHome.vibeDesc: Just describe what you want in the Vibe Sandbox, and the built-in AI spits out luxurious Tailwind HTML directly.
SaaSHome.stackDesc: Built on Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS and Prisma. The ultimate modern tech stack with no compromises.
SaaSHome.cartwrightDesc1: Cartwright is our in-house built self-custody e-commerce and SaaS platform. It's lightning fast, state-of-the-art and 100% free to use in its basic form.
SaaSHome.cartwrightDesc2: Just like in the crypto world, where you have full control of your wallet without a middleman, Cartwright gives you true ownership of your site. We don't believe you should pay monthly licenses for a basic system. At Cartwright, you only pay for our time to set up, design and tailor the platform.

CartwrightPage.description: Cartwright is an AI-native self-custody e-commerce and SaaS platform. Built on Next.js, Vercel, and Vibe Templates.
CartwrightPage.terminalOk2: ✓ Vibe Templates & Local AI Designer active
CartwrightPage.perfDesc: Cartwright is built for Vibe Coding. Generate beautiful Tailwind designs in Cursor or Vercel v0, and inject them directly into the platform live. No traditional front-end coding required.
CartwrightPage.tenantDesc: In addition to OpenAI and Gemini, Cartwright now supports local, free open-source AI models like Gemma 4 via Ollama. Save money on API calls and run your business privately.
CartwrightPage.i18nDesc: A true Software 3.0 i18n layer. Upload a Vibe Design in one language, and the built-in AI instantly translates all text to the entire world, while preserving your code intact.
CartwrightPage.cmsDesc: Buy and set up a global phone number directly in your dashboard. Make and receive calls in the browser, or forward everything to your iPhone with our built-in Phone.inc API integration.
CartwrightPage.stripeDesc: 1-click deploy to Vercel's global edge network. No slow web hosts or failing plugins. Your website is built and hosted to be the fastest in the world.
CartwrightPage.vibeDesc: Make your webshop machine-readable for future AI agents. Cartwright automatically serves catalogs and MCP tools so AI (like ChatGPT) can buy products directly from your site.
CartwrightPage.setupDesc: Once your site is generated, the platform automatically guides you through domain migration (MX and TXT records) and e-mail setup with Google Workspace or Simply.com.

UseCases.title: Selected Cases
UseCases.description: See what's possible when combining AI, exceptional design and modern web technology.
UseCases.cartwrightDesc: Multi-tenant AI E-commerce platform built from scratch with modern technology. Supports both webshops and SaaS agencies in the same codebase.
UseCases.hegnsDesc: Complete e-commerce solution with an advanced 3D fence configurator, automatic quote generation and order management built directly on Cartwright.
